paragraphs: Streamline Healthcare Solutions sells SmartCare, an electronic health record platform for the Behavioral Health and Human Services market. SmartCare is hosted on the Azure cloud and is sold as a cloud-based EHR system. Each organization has its own instance of the application, and the application runs on any device with Google Chrome or Microsoft Edge.

The platform is sold as one application managing all types of services across all levels of care, rather than as connected separate systems. The solution areas listed include clinical care management, revenue cycle management, inpatient and residential care, day services, primary care, and reporting. Clinical care management covers intake, assessment, care planning, services, progress notes and results, with a validation system that flags requirements that are out of compliance.

The buyers described are behavioral health providers offering services that include foster care and adoption, substance abuse disorder care, and intellectual and developmental disabilities care. Certified Community Behavioral Health Clinics and Managed Behavioral Health Organizations are also named among them. Clients quoted on the site include Valley Oaks Health, George Junior Republic and The Nord Center.

quote.text: SmartCare™ sets a new standard for Behavioral Health and Human Services EHRs.
